title: Longest Substring with At Most Two Distinct Characters
description: Find the longest substring containing at most two different characters.

data.text: Given a string `s`, return the length of the longest substring that contains at most two distinct characters.

data.title: Check each window O(n^2)
Grow-shrink O(n)
What improved?
data.text: A dictionary tracks character counts inside the window. We grow the window and shrink only when a third character appears.
